update.message: Major deviation before preamble: install-shipsmooth.sh is NOT launcher-agnostic (05 premise wrong). :40 BIN=$RUNTIME_DIR/bin/shipsmooth and :65-66 EXTRACTED_BIN=bin/shipsmooth are hardcoded, so a zip containing bin/shipsmooth-beta dies 'extracted archive is missing bin/shipsmooth'. bin/$NAME is not a safe fix: opencode dev passes NAME=shipsmooth-dev with a Java bin/shipsmooth. Also: hook commands in harness/shared/build.gradle.kts:213,223,233,256 hardcode the 'shipsmooth' NAME argument (and :213 the plugins/cache/bitkentech/shipsmooth fallback path), which Task 2 must cover. Awaiting human decision: keep launcher bin/shipsmooth vs optional 3rd installer arg vs bin/$NAME.

Unblocked by plan-115-v2: the beta gets a separate install-shipsmooth-beta.sh (Java install-shipsmooth.sh untouched). Task 2 scope widened (beta installer, HookCommandRenderer script detection, lint task, Claude hook command :213), risk stays Medium. Task ids/risks unchanged from v1.
